description: Metadata for the original sign artwork. `label` is the sign's meaning (used in answers and explanations). `visualDescription` is shape, colour and symbols ONLY — never the meaning — because it is the accessible name shown to screen-reader users, and a description that stated the meaning would answer sign-recognition questions outright. `basis` records which official source establishes the design and meaning. The matching SVG artwork lives in src/signs/registry.tsx, keyed by the same id.

stop.label: Stop
stop.visualDescription: An eight-sided sign with a red background and the word STOP in white capital letters.
stop.basis: Traffic Signs Regulations: block capital white letters on a red background; Driver's Handbook ch.3 p.80.

yield.label: Yield
yield.visualDescription: A downward-pointing triangle with a red border and a white centre, containing the word YIELD.
yield.basis: Traffic Signs Regulations: red inverted triangle with a white centre; Driver's Handbook ch.3 p.80.

maximum-speed-50.label: Maximum speed 50 km/h
maximum-speed-50.visualDescription: A white rectangular sign with black lettering reading MAXIMUM, the number 50, and km/h.
maximum-speed-50.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.3 p.90; Traffic Signs Regulations RB-1.

maximum-speed-80.label: Maximum speed 80 km/h
maximum-speed-80.visualDescription: A white rectangular sign with black lettering reading MAXIMUM, the number 80, and km/h.
maximum-speed-80.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.3 p.90; Traffic Signs Regulations RB-1.

speed-limit-change-ahead.label: Change in maximum speed limit ahead
speed-limit-change-ahead.visualDescription: A yellow diamond containing a small white speed-limit panel showing MAXIMUM 50 km/h.

one-way.label: One way — traffic may travel only in the direction of the arrow
one-way.visualDescription: A wide black rectangular sign with a white arrow pointing right and the words ONE WAY.

do-not-enter.label: Do not enter
do-not-enter.visualDescription: A white rectangular sign containing a red circle with a wide white horizontal bar across it.

do-not-pass.label: Do not pass
do-not-pass.visualDescription: A white sign showing two car silhouettes inside a red circle with a red diagonal line through it.
do-not-pass.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.3 p.83: two cars in a red circle with a line through it means do not pass.

passing-permitted.label: Passing permitted
passing-permitted.visualDescription: A white sign showing two car silhouettes inside a green circle with no line through it.
passing-permitted.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.3 p.83: two cars in a green circle means that passing is permitted.

no-left-turn.label: No left turn
no-left-turn.visualDescription: A white sign with a left-pointing curved arrow inside a red circle with a red diagonal line through it.

no-right-turn.label: No right turn
no-right-turn.visualDescription: A white sign with a right-pointing curved arrow inside a red circle with a red diagonal line through it.

no-right-turn-on-red.label: No right turn on a red signal — wait for the green light
no-right-turn-on-red.visualDescription: A white sign with a right-curving arrow crossed out in red, above the words ON RED.

no-u-turn.label: No U-turn
no-u-turn.visualDescription: A white sign with a U-shaped arrow inside a red circle with a red diagonal line through it.

no-turns.label: No turns
no-turns.visualDescription: A white sign with two opposing curved arrows inside a red circle with a red diagonal line through it.

no-parking.label: No parking in either direction of this sign
no-parking.visualDescription: A white sign with the letter P inside a red circle with a red diagonal line through it, and arrows pointing both ways beneath.

no-stopping.label: No stopping
no-stopping.visualDescription: A white sign with the letter S inside a red circle with a red diagonal line through it, and arrows pointing both ways beneath.

accessible-parking.label: Parking reserved for persons with a mobility disability
accessible-parking.visualDescription: A sign with a blue background and a white symbol of a person seated in a wheelchair.

truck-route.label: Truck route — trucks may proceed only in the direction of the arrow
truck-route.visualDescription: A white rectangular sign reading TRUCK ROUTE with a black truck symbol and a right-pointing arrow.

keep-right-of-island.label: Keep to the right of the traffic island or obstruction
keep-right-of-island.visualDescription: A white sign with a black upward arrow bending to the right around a black oval shape.

hazard-marker-keep-right.label: Hazard marker — drive to the right of this sign
hazard-marker-keep-right.visualDescription: A tall yellow rectangular sign with black diagonal stripes sloping down to the right.
hazard-marker-keep-right.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.3 p.90: if the black lines are sloped to the right, drive to the right of the sign.

slippery-when-wet.label: Slippery when wet
slippery-when-wet.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with a black car symbol above two wavy skid marks.

traffic-signal-ahead.label: Traffic signal lights ahead
traffic-signal-ahead.visualDescription: A yellow diamond containing a black traffic-light housing with red, amber and green lamps.

stop-sign-ahead.label: Stop sign ahead
stop-sign-ahead.visualDescription: A yellow diamond containing a small red eight-sided sign with the word STOP and an arrow pointing to it.

merge.label: Merge — prepare to merge with other vehicles
merge.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with a straight black arrow and a second line joining it from the right.

road-narrows.label: Road narrows ahead
road-narrows.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with two black lines that angle inward toward each other as they rise.

hidden-intersection.label: Hidden intersection ahead
hidden-intersection.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with a black cross shape where one arm is drawn as a broken line.

steep-decline.label: Steep decline ahead — you may need to use a lower gear
steep-decline.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with a black truck symbol tilted nose-down on a descending slope.

bump.label: Bump or rough road ahead
bump.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with a black horizontal line that rises into a rounded hump.

divided-highway-ends.label: Divided highway ends — two-way traffic beyond this point
divided-highway-ends.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with two black lanes that converge from a split into a single roadway.

divided-highway-ahead.label: Divided highway ahead
divided-highway-ahead.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with a single black lane that splits into two around a central divider.

right-curve.label: Curve to the right ahead
right-curve.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with a black arrow that bends to the right as it rises.

sharp-turn-right.label: Sharp turn or bend in the roadway ahead
sharp-turn-right.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with a black right-angled arrow above a black-and-white checkerboard band.
sharp-turn-right.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.3 p.92: checkerboard design is a warning to slow down; the arrow indicates the direction of the roadway.

chevron-right.label: Chevron — the roadway turns sharply in the direction shown
chevron-right.visualDescription: A tall yellow rectangular sign with a single large black arrowhead pointing to the right.
chevron-right.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.3 p.93: chevron signs are posted in groups to guide drivers around sharp curves.

low-clearance.label: Low clearance — overhead clearance as shown
low-clearance.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with two facing black arrows separated by a gap, above a height measurement.

right-lane-ends.label: Right lane ends ahead
right-lane-ends.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with two black lanes where the right-hand one tapers and ends.

narrow-structure.label: Narrow structure ahead
narrow-structure.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with two black vertical bars close together and lane lines passing between them.

truck-entering.label: Truck entering the roadway ahead
truck-entering.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with a black truck symbol on a side road joining a main road.

animal-crossing.label: Watch for large animals crossing the road
animal-crossing.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with the black silhouette of a moose.
animal-crossing.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.5 p.146: animal crossing signs warn where there is a known danger of large animals such as moose, deer or cattle.

school-area.label: School area
school-area.visualDescription: A five-sided sign with a fluorescent yellow-green background and two black figures of children walking.
school-area.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.3 p.80: five-sided, fluorescent yellow-green, two school children pedestrian symbols in black; standard across Nova Scotia since 1 June 2001.

school-crosswalk.label: School crosswalk
school-crosswalk.visualDescription: A five-sided fluorescent yellow-green sign with black figures of children above a striped crossing.

pedestrian-crosswalk.label: Pedestrian crosswalk
pedestrian-crosswalk.visualDescription: A sign with a black figure of a walking person, above a striped crossing.
pedestrian-crosswalk.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.3 p.88; Traffic Signs Regulations: black symbol of a pedestrian on a white background.

playground.label: Playground ahead — reduce speed and watch for children
playground.visualDescription: A fluorescent yellow-green diamond with the black silhouette of a running child.

bicycle-route.label: Bicycle route — share the road with cyclists
bicycle-route.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with the black silhouette of a bicycle.
bicycle-route.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.2 pp.69-70: cyclists have the same rights and responsibilities as motorists and drivers must share the road.

railway-crossbuck.label: Railway crossing (crossbuck)
railway-crossbuck.visualDescription: Two long white blades crossed in an X shape with a red reflective border.
railway-crossbuck.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.3 p.81: a crossbuck sign with a white background and a red reflective border, used at the crossing itself.

railway-tracks-tab.label: Number of sets of tracks at this crossing
railway-tracks-tab.visualDescription: A small white rectangular plate showing the numeral 2, mounted below a crossing sign.
railway-tracks-tab.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.3 p.81: a smaller sign below the crossbuck indicates if there is more than one set of tracks.

lane-right-turn-only.label: Right turn only from this lane
lane-right-turn-only.visualDescription: A white rectangular sign with a single black arrow curving to the right.

lane-straight-or-left.label: Straight through or left turn only from this lane
lane-straight-or-left.visualDescription: A white rectangular sign with two black arrows: one pointing straight up, one curving to the left.

two-way-left-turn-lane.label: Two-way left turn lane — reserved for left-turning vehicles from both directions
two-way-left-turn-lane.visualDescription: A white rectangular sign with two black arrows curving to the left, one pointing up and one pointing down.

route-102.label: Highway 102 — a 100-series controlled-access provincial highway
route-102.visualDescription: A shield-shaped sign with a white background and the black numerals 102, above the words NOVA SCOTIA.

guide-destination.label: Guide sign — information, directions and distances
guide-destination.visualDescription: A green rectangular sign with white lettering reading Halifax 12 km.
guide-destination.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.3 p.83: guidance signs are rectangular, usually with a green background and white letters.

two-way-traffic.label: Two-way traffic — normal two-way rules of the road apply
two-way-traffic.visualDescription: A yellow diamond with two black arrows side by side, one pointing up and one pointing down.

wz-construction-ahead.label: Construction ahead — prepare for unusual road conditions
wz-construction-ahead.visualDescription: An orange diamond with a black symbol of a person shovelling.
wz-construction-ahead.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.3 pp.94-101: work zones are marked with orange warning signs with messages in black letters.

wz-workers-ahead.label: Workers are active at the site
wz-workers-ahead.visualDescription: An orange diamond with a black figure of a worker, with small orange flags mounted at its lower corners.
wz-workers-ahead.basis: Driver's Handbook ch.3 p.101: human activity signs are used only when workers are present; red/orange flags are used on them.

wz-traffic-control-person.label: Traffic control person ahead
wz-traffic-control-person.visualDescription: An orange diamond with a black figure holding a paddle on a pole.

wz-construction-distance-ahead.label: Construction activities begin a stated distance ahead
wz-construction-distance-ahead.visualDescription: An orange diamond containing the text 1.5 km with a downward arrow.

wz-end-construction.label: The road has returned to normal — expect no more impact from road work
wz-end-construction.visualDescription: An orange rectangular sign with the black words END CONSTRUCTION.

wz-uneven-lanes.label: Difference in elevation between the lanes
wz-uneven-lanes.visualDescription: An orange diamond with a black stepped profile showing one surface higher than the next.

wz-flashing-arrow-right.label: Flashing light unit with a right arrow — the lane ahead is closed, move over
wz-flashing-arrow-right.visualDescription: A black panel with a bright arrow of lamps pointing to the right.

pm-double-solid-yellow.label: Double solid yellow centre line — you may not cross to pass in either direction
pm-double-solid-yellow.visualDescription: A grey road surface with two continuous yellow lines running down the middle.

pm-broken-yellow.label: Broken yellow centre line — passing with care is permitted in both directions
pm-broken-yellow.visualDescription: A grey road surface with a single dashed yellow line running down the middle.

pm-solid-and-broken-yellow.label: Solid yellow line beside a broken yellow line — only the side with the broken line may pass
pm-solid-and-broken-yellow.visualDescription: A grey road surface with one continuous yellow line and, beside it, a dashed yellow line.

pm-white-lane-line.label: White lane line — separates lanes of traffic moving in the same direction
pm-white-lane-line.visualDescription: A grey road surface with a dashed white line between two lanes and solid white edge lines.
